video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Practice | October 27, 2026

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on Kawhi Leonard's injury and team resilience
quotes.excerpt: Injuries are a part of the game. That's why you have a whole team.
quotes.quote: Injuries are a part of the game. Obviously we wish everybody could play every game, but injuries are a part of the game. That's why you have a whole team. Obviously, we hope that he recovers and comes back as fast as possible, because as you can see when he's in the lineup, how much it changes our team. But until he gets back, we got to figure it out. We can't just let go of the rope. We can't just have games like we did in Minnesota.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the Raptors adjusting to Kawhi Leonard's absence: Injuries are a part of the game. We hope he recovers as fast as possible, but until he gets back, we got to figure it out. We can't just let go of the rope.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the team approach to dealing with Kawhi Leonard's current injury.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on building team resilience through early season injuries
quotes.excerpt: We've built up a resiliency that way, and just also knowing other teams, like we play Orlando
quotes.quote: We've already even in years past had some injuries that we have to to overcome. I mean we still made the playoffs and stuff. Kawhi was out a lot of games, Jakob was down a lot last year. So we've built up a resiliency that way, and just also knowing other teams, like we play Orlando next two games, they're down two starters right now. So it's not just us, it's happening to other other people. So we got to be ready to give everybody our best shot.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says the Raptors are leaning on past experience to handle early season injuries: We've built up a resiliency that way. It's not just us, it's happening to other people. So we got to be ready to give everybody our best shot.

structured.context: RJ Barrett reflects on the team's history of overcoming injuries to key players like Kawhi Leonard and Jakob Poeltl.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the team's next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: It's next man up mentality. He started a lot of games for me last year when I was out.
quotes.quote: I don't think he need any help. He didn't look like he needed help to me. No, he got it. He got it. He's been, said we've been, we've been through this before. So it's next man up mentality. He started a lot of games for me last year when I was out, like started for Quick in stuff when he was out like, so guys are ready. We're ready for this moment.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the next man up mentality for the Raptors: He's been through this before. So it's next man up mentality. Guys are ready. We're ready for this moment.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the team's next-man-up mentality in response to player absences.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on Gradey Dick's development and hard play
quotes.excerpt: You can clean up some of those areas just by playing hard.
quotes.quote: He plays hard. That's one way to, there's certain things as a rookie that you just don't know yet and there's no other way than going out there on the court and getting that experience. But you can clean up some of those areas just by playing hard. Crashing all the time, getting all the rebounds that he's getting, and he played, he got to some stuff offensively as well last game. So just continue to play hard, do all the little effort things, and your game will open up.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on Gradey Dick's development: There's no other way than going out there on the court and getting that experience. But you can clean up some of those areas just by playing hard. Your game will open up.

structured.context: RJ Barrett provides an assessment of rookie Gradey Dick's development and his effort on the court.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the mental challenge of being a young NBA player
quotes.excerpt: It's the best players in the world, man. So it's very different. It's a completely different pace.
quotes.quote: It's the best players in the world, man. So it's very different. It's a completely different pace to the game, better players, bigger, stronger players. So like I said, just playing hard and continuing to watch the film just to figure out where you could be effective on the court, especially specifically with the team you're on and you know how the system goes. But there's no substitute for for hustle. You get a steal, some rebounds, like you get yourself involved in the game that way.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the transition to the NBA: It's the best players in the world. It's a completely different pace to the game, better players, bigger, stronger players. There's no substitute for hustle.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the challenges young players face when adjusting to the pace and physicality of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on learning from tough losses
quotes.excerpt: Just look back at it. You still go over the tape, see what you could have did.
quotes.quote: Just look back at it. You still go over the tape, see what you could have did. Shots wasn't falling for real. It is what it is. Just find that ways how you can impact it. Still feel like I did a great job defensively. Just come out with something positive. Go to the next game, go back home. We got a next game tomorrow. That's all you really got to do.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on bouncing back from a tough shooting night: Shots wasn't falling for real. It is what it is. Just find that ways how you can impact it. Still feel like I did a great job defensively.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on missed opportunities and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: I feel like all the shots obviously I missed a lot of open shots, my threes wide open.
quotes.quote: I feel like all the shots obviously I missed a lot of open shots, my threes wide open. Of course the helping in threes open. You know, obviously my middies wasn't falling, they had help in the paint. So come really try to get all the way to the rim. Obviously miss some easy ones as well, but on defensive man I feel like I still had a great impact. So like I said, just look for a positive. It is what it is, go to the next game, try to go dominate.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on his offensive struggles: I feel like all the shots obviously I missed a lot of open shots. My middies wasn't falling, they had help in the paint. So come really try to get all the way to the rim.

quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' three-point shooting improvement
